# **glmtlp**: An R Package For Truncated Lasso Penalty

![glmtp icon](reference/figures/README-GLMTLP.png)

Efficient procedures for constrained likelihood estimation with
truncated lasso penalty (Shen et al., 2010; Zhang 2010) for linear and
generalized linear models.

**Note**: this is a repo for the version published on CRAN. Please check
[chunlinli/glmtlp](https://github.com/chunlinli/glmtlp) for new features
such as constrained likelihood inference, regression on summary data,
memory efficiency, Gaussian graphical models, and more.

## Installation

You can install the released version of glmtlp from
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

\
[`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(``"glmtlp"``)`

## Examples for Gaussian Regression Models

The following are three examples which show you how to use `glmtlp` to
fit gaussian regression models:

\
[`library`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)`(`[`glmtlp`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/)`)`\
[`data`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/data.html)`(``"gau_data"``)`\
[`colnames`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/colnames.html)`(``gau_data``$``X``)``[``gau_data``$``beta`` ``!=`` ``0``]`\
`#> [1] "V1"  "V6"  "V10" "V15" "V20"`

\
`# Cross-Validation using TLP penalty`\
`cv.fit`` ``<-`` `[`cv.glmtlp`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/reference/cv.glmtlp.md)`(``gau_data``$``X``, ``gau_data``$``y``, family ``=`` ``"gaussian"``, penalty ``=`` ``"tlp"``, ncores``=``2``)`\
[`coef`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/coef.html)`(``cv.fit``)``[`[`abs`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/MathFun.html)`(`[`coef`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/coef.html)`(``cv.fit``)``)`` ``>`` ``0``]`\
`#>    intercept           V1           V6          V10          V15          V20 `\
`#> -0.009678041  1.240223517  0.883202180  0.725708239  1.125994003  0.981402236`\
[`plot`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/plot.default.html)`(``cv.fit``)`

![cross-validation plot using TLP
penalty](reference/figures/README-example1-1.png)

\
\
`# Single Model Fit using TLP penalty`\
`fit`` ``<-`` `[`glmtlp`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/reference/glmtlp.md)`(``gau_data``$``X``, ``gau_data``$``y``, family ``=`` ``"gaussian"``, penalty ``=`` ``"tlp"``)`\
[`coef`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/coef.html)`(``fit``, lambda ``=`` ``cv.fit``$``lambda.min``)`\
`#>    intercept           V1           V2           V3           V4           V5 `\
`#> -0.009678041  1.240223517  0.000000000  0.000000000  0.000000000  0.000000000 `\
`#>           V6           V7           V8           V9          V10          V11 `\
`#>  0.883202180  0.000000000  0.000000000  0.000000000  0.725708239  0.000000000 `\
`#>          V12          V13          V14          V15          V16          V17 `\
`#>  0.000000000  0.000000000  0.000000000  1.125994003  0.000000000  0.000000000 `\
`#>          V18          V19          V20 `\
`#>  0.000000000  0.000000000  0.981402236`\
[`predict`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/predict.html)`(``fit``, X ``=`` ``gau_data``$``X``[``1``:``5``, ``]``, lambda ``=`` ``cv.fit``$``lambda.min``)`\
`#> [1]  0.1906465  2.2279723 -1.4256042  0.9313886 -2.8152522`\
[`plot`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/plot.default.html)`(``fit``, xvar ``=`` ``"log_lambda"``, label ``=`` ``TRUE``)`

![solution path plot for single model fit using TLP
penalty](reference/figures/README-example1-2.png)

\
`# Cross-Validation using L0 penalty`\
`cv.fit`` ``<-`` `[`cv.glmtlp`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/reference/cv.glmtlp.md)`(``gau_data``$``X``, ``gau_data``$``y``, family ``=`` ``"gaussian"``, penalty ``=`` ``"l0"``, ncores``=``2``)`\
[`coef`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/coef.html)`(``cv.fit``)``[`[`abs`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/MathFun.html)`(`[`coef`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/coef.html)`(``cv.fit``)``)`` ``>`` ``0``]`\
`#>    intercept           V1           V6          V10          V15          V20 `\
`#> -0.009687042  1.240319880  0.883378583  0.725607300  1.125958218  0.981544178`\
[`plot`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/plot.default.html)`(``cv.fit``)`

![cross-validation plot using L0
penalty](reference/figures/README-example2-1.png)

\
`# Single Model Fit using L0 penalty`\
`fit`` ``<-`` `[`glmtlp`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/reference/glmtlp.md)`(``gau_data``$``X``, ``gau_data``$``y``, family ``=`` ``"gaussian"``, penalty ``=`` ``"l0"``)`\
[`coef`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/coef.html)`(``fit``, kappa ``=`` ``cv.fit``$``kappa.min``)`\
`#>    intercept           V1           V2           V3           V4           V5 `\
`#> -0.009687042  1.240319880  0.000000000  0.000000000  0.000000000  0.000000000 `\
`#>           V6           V7           V8           V9          V10          V11 `\
`#>  0.883378583  0.000000000  0.000000000  0.000000000  0.725607300  0.000000000 `\
`#>          V12          V13          V14          V15          V16          V17 `\
`#>  0.000000000  0.000000000  0.000000000  1.125958218  0.000000000  0.000000000 `\
`#>          V18          V19          V20 `\
`#>  0.000000000  0.000000000  0.981544178`\

`#> [1]  0.190596  2.228306 -1.425994  0.931749 -2.815322`\

![solution path plot for single model fit using L0

## Examples for Logistic Regression Models

The following are three examples which show you how to use `glmtlp` to
fit logistic regression models:

\
[`data`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/data.html)`(``"bin_data"``)`\
[`colnames`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/colnames.html)`(``bin_data``$``X``)``[``bin_data``$``beta`` ``!=`` ``0``]`\
`#> [1] "V1"  "V6"  "V10" "V15" "V20"`

\
`# Cross-Validation using TLP penalty`\
`cv.fit`` ``<-`` `[`cv.glmtlp`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/reference/cv.glmtlp.md)`(``bin_data``$``X``, ``bin_data``$``y``, family ``=`` ``"binomial"``, penalty ``=`` ``"tlp"``, ncores``=``2``)`\
[`coef`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/coef.html)`(``cv.fit``)``[`[`abs`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/MathFun.html)`(`[`coef`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/coef.html)`(``cv.fit``)``)`` ``>`` ``0``]`\
`#>  intercept         V6        V20 `\
`#> -0.1347141  0.8256183  0.9940325`\
[`plot`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/plot.default.html)`(``cv.fit``)`\
`#> Warning: Removed 98 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range`\
`` #> (`geom_line()`). ``\
`#> Warning: Removed 98 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range`\
`` #> (`geom_point()`). ``

![cross-validation plot using TLP penalty for binary
data](reference/figures/README-example4-1.png)

\
`# Single Model Fit using TLP penalty`\
`fit`` ``<-`` `[`glmtlp`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/reference/glmtlp.md)`(``bin_data``$``X``, ``bin_data``$``y``, family ``=`` ``"binomial"``, penalty ``=`` ``"tlp"``)`\
[`coef`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/coef.html)`(``fit``, lambda ``=`` ``cv.fit``$``lambda.min``)`\
`#>  intercept         V1         V2         V3         V4         V5         V6 `\
`#> -0.1347141  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.8256183 `\
`#>         V7         V8         V9        V10        V11        V12        V13 `\
`#>  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.0000000 `\
`#>        V14        V15        V16        V17        V18        V19        V20 `\
`#>  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.0000000  0.9940325`\
[`predict`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/predict.html)`(``fit``, X ``=`` ``bin_data``$``X``[``1``:``5``, ``]``, type ``=`` ``"response"``, lambda ``=`` ``cv.fit``$``lambda.min``)`\
`#> [1] 0.42562483 0.89838483 0.09767039 0.90898462 0.20822294`\
[`plot`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/plot.default.html)`(``fit``, xvar ``=`` ``"log_lambda"``, label ``=`` ``TRUE``)`

![solution path plot for single model fit using TLP penalty for binary
data](reference/figures/README-example4-2.png)

\
`# Cross-Validation using L0 penalty`\
`cv.fit`` ``<-`` `[`cv.glmtlp`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/reference/cv.glmtlp.md)`(``bin_data``$``X``, ``bin_data``$``y``, family ``=`` ``"binomial"``, penalty ``=`` ``"l0"``, ncores``=``2``)`\

`#>  intercept         V6        V20 `\
`#> -0.1347137  0.8256471  0.9940180`\
[`plot`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/plot.default.html)`(``cv.fit``)`

![cross-validation plot using L0 penalty for binary
data](reference/figures/README-example5-1.png)

\
`# Single Model Fit using L0 penalty`\
`fit`` ``<-`` `[`glmtlp`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/reference/glmtlp.md)`(``bin_data``$``X``, ``bin_data``$``y``, family ``=`` ``"binomial"``, penalty ``=`` ``"l0"``)`\

If you find this project useful, please consider citing

``` R
@article{
    author = {Chunlin Li, Yu Yang, Chong Wu, Xiaotong Shen, Wei Pan},
    title = {{glmtlp: An R package for truncated Lasso penalty}},
    year = {2022}
}
```

## References

Li, C., Shen, X., & Pan, W. (2021). Inference for a large directed
graphical model with interventions. *arXiv preprint* arXiv:2110.03805.
<https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.03805>.

Shen, X., Pan, W., & Zhu, Y. (2012). Likelihood-based selection and
sharp parameter estimation. *Journal of the American Statistical
Association*, 107(497), 223-232.
<https://doi.org/10.1080/01621459.2011.645783>.

Shen, X., Pan, W., Zhu, Y., & Zhou, H. (2013). On constrained and
regularized high-dimensional regression. *Annals of the Institute of
Statistical Mathematics*, 65(5), 807-832.
<https://doi.org/10.1007/s10463-012-0396-3>.

Tibshirani, R., Bien, J., Friedman, J., Hastie, T., Simon, N., Taylor,
J., & Tibshirani, R. J. (2012). Strong rules for discarding predictors
in lasso‐type problems. *Journal of the Royal Statistical Society:
Series B (Statistical Methodology)*, 74(2), 245-266.
<https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1467-9868.2011.01004.x>.

Yang, Y. & Zou, H. A coordinate majorization descent algorithm for l1
penalized learning. *Journal of Statistical Computation and Simulation*
84.1 (2014): 84-95. <https://doi.org/10.1080/00949655.2012.695374>.

Zhu, Y., Shen, X., & Pan, W. (2020). On high-dimensional constrained
maximum likelihood inference. *Journal of the American Statistical
Association*, 115(529), 217-230.
<https://doi.org/10.1080/01621459.2018.1540986>.

Zhu, Y. (2017). An augmented ADMM algorithm with application to the
generalized lasso problem. *Journal of Computational and Graphical
Statistics*, 26(1), 195-204.
<https://doi.org/10.1080/10618600.2015.1114491>.

Part of the code is adapted from
[**glmnet**](https://github.com/cran/glmnet),
[**ncvreg**](https://github.com/pbreheny/ncvreg/), and
[**biglasso**](https://github.com/pbreheny/biglasso/).

**Warm thanks to the authors of above open-sourced softwares.**

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bin_data`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/reference/bin_data.md) : A
  simulated binomial data set.
- [`cv.glmtlp()`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/reference/cv.glmtlp.md) :
  Cross-validation for glmtlp
- [`gau_data`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/reference/gau_data.md) : A
  simulated gaussian data set.
- [`gen.binomial.data()`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/reference/gen.binomial.data.md)
  : Simulate a binomial data set
- [`gen.gaussian.data()`](https://yuyangyy.com/glmtlp/reference/gen.gaussian.data.md)
  : Simulate a gaussian data set
